description: IT service management: incidents, records and attachments.

validation.method: All surfaces run live against a ServiceNow PDI (a developer instance, Zurich) on 2026-06-04 with Basic auth: Table CRUD (create / get / update PATCH+PUT / delete on incident, delete verified by 404), list_records (encoded query + fields + pagination), aggregate (Stats group-by count), get_current_user, list_tables, and the table/fields/group_by dynselect resolvers. Attachment upload (binary /file) -> list -> download -> delete round-trip with the downloaded bytes byte-for-byte matching the upload. insert_import_set + get_import_set_result against imp_user (transform status surfaced). Trigger e2e-tested via bun test with the windmill-client fake. All created records cleaned up.

sources.table_crud: HIGH - run live (create/get/update PATCH & PUT/delete on incident)
sources.aggregate_stats: HIGH - run live (/api/now/stats group-by count on incident)
sources.attachment: HIGH - run live (binary /file upload -> list -> download -> delete round-trip; downloaded bytes verified equal)
sources.import_set: HIGH - run live (POST /api/now/import/imp_user + GET result; top-level {import_set,staging_table,result} envelope, transform status surfaced)
sources.trigger: HIGH - e2e-tested live via bun test (first run sets watermark + no backlog, second run emits the new record)
sources.dropdowns: HIGH - run live (sys_db_object table list; sys_dictionary super_class inheritance walk confirmed - incident resolves 106 fields incl. task-inherited short_description/priority/state)

low_confidence_fields: trigger datetime comparison assumes the integration user's timezone is UTC/GMT (validated with the PDI admin user, whose TZ is UTC); a non-UTC integration user could shift the sys_updated_on> watermark boundary by the offset

pagination.notes: Table API pages with sysparm_offset + sysparm_limit. Each page response carries a Link header (RFC 5988) with rel="first"/"prev"/"next"/"last" full URLs, plus X-Total-Count with the total match count. Add sysparm_no_count=true to skip the count on huge tables. The list_records action exposes limit+offset and returns one page; iterate offset until fewer than limit rows return.

gotchas: Base path is {instance_url}/api/now; instance_url lives on the resource. Auth is Basic (username:password) OR Bearer token — scripts send Bearer when auth.token is set, otherwise Basic. Both hit identical paths.

Table/Attachment/Stats reads/writes return a {"result": ...} envelope: list/stats -> result is an array, get/create/update -> result is an object. EXCEPTION: the Import Set API (POST /api/now/import/{staging}, GET .../{sys_id}) returns a TOP-LEVEL object {import_set, staging_table, result:[...]} with NO outer 'result' wrapper. Scripts return the raw JSON (envelope intact).
Datetimes are 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' in UTC with NO trailing 'Z'. Used directly in encoded queries, e.g. sys_updated_on>2026-01-01 00:00:00.

sysparm_query is an ENCODED query string: '^' = AND clause separator, '^OR' = OR, operators =, !=, LIKE, >=, <=, IN, STARTSWITH, ORDERBY, ORDERBYDESC. A literal '^' inside a value must be doubled to '^^'. Example: active=true^priority=1^ORDERBYDESCsys_updated_on.
System fields sys_id, sys_created_on, sys_updated_on, sys_created_by are auto-managed; do not send them on create/update.
DELETE (record and attachment) returns 204 No Content with an empty body — guard with `if (response.status === 204) return { success: true }` before response.json().
Update: PATCH partial-updates; PUT replaces the whole record (clears omitted fields). update_record sends PUT when replace=true, PATCH otherwise.

Attachment upload uses POST /api/now/attachment/file with table_name, table_sys_id, file_name in the QUERY STRING and the raw file bytes as the body (Content-Type = the file's MIME type), NOT multipart. Returns 201. Download is GET /api/now/attachment/{sys_id}/file (raw bytes).
Import Set transform runs SYNCHRONOUSLY. A result[].status of 'error' is an application-level failure even on HTTP 200/201 — inspect result[].status / error_message, don't trust the HTTP code alone.

Table-name DROPDOWN comes from GET /api/now/table/sys_db_object?sysparm_fields=name,label (use the 'name' as the value). A table's COLUMNS come from sys_dictionary — but sys_dictionary stores each field once, under the table where it is DEFINED, so name=<table> returns ONLY that table's own fields. Extended tables (incident/change_request/sc_task all extend task) inherit columns like short_description/priority/assigned_to/state that live on the parent. To get the full column set, walk sys_db_object.super_class up the hierarchy (GET sys_db_object?sysparm_query=name=<t>&sysparm_fields=super_class.name, repeat) and query GET sys_dictionary?sysparm_query=nameIN<table>,<ancestors>^elementISNOTEMPTY&sysparm_fields=element,column_label (elementISNOTEMPTY drops the collection/meta row).
Table API enforces row- and field-level ACLs: a 200 can omit fields the user can't read; inaccessible tables/ops return 403.

enums.incident_state_note: incident.state and priority/urgency/impact are instance-configurable; defaults: state 1=New,2=In Progress,3=On Hold,6=Resolved,7=Closed,8=Canceled; priority/urgency/impact 1-5. On task/incident, priority is CALCULATED from impact+urgency (a priority value sent on create/update is recomputed/ignored) — set impact+urgency instead. Never hardcode for generic actions.

errors.401: Authentication failed or OAuth token expired/invalid. Check username/password or refresh the bearer token.
errors.403: ACL denies the table or operation, or the user lacks the required role (e.g. rest_api_explorer / table ACL). Response: {"error":{"message":"User Not Authorized"}}.
errors.404: No Record found (bad sys_id) or Invalid table (bad/inaccessible table name, common Import Set staging-table error).
errors.400: Bad encoded query, invalid field name, or malformed request body.

resource_type.name: servicenow
resource_type.description: ServiceNow instance credential. Set instance_url to your instance base (https://<instance>.service-now.com). Authenticate with EITHER Basic auth (username + password) OR an OAuth 2.0 bearer token — scripts send a Bearer header when token is set, otherwise Basic auth.

instance_url.description: Instance base URL, e.g. https://a developer a ServiceNow instance (no trailing slash). Every REST call is made against this host.

password.description: Basic auth password. Leave blank when using an OAuth bearer token.

token.description: OAuth 2.0 access token (Bearer). Populated automatically when you connect via Windmill's ServiceNow OAuth flow (admin configures the instance + client id/secret in instance settings), or paste one manually. Provide this instead of username/password to authenticate with OAuth.

username.description: Basic auth username. Leave blank when using an OAuth bearer token.

scripts.description: Count records on a table (Aggregate API), optionally filtered by an encoded query and grouped by a field.
scripts.terms: servicenow aggregate records count records on a table (aggregate api), optionally filtered by an encoded query and grouped by a field.

scripts.description: Insert a record into any table (incident, change_request, sys_user, cmdb_ci, or a custom table). Pick the table from a live dropdown and pass a column/value map.
scripts.terms: servicenow create record insert a record into any table (incident, change_request, sys_user, cmdb_ci, or a custom table). pick the table from a live dropdown and pass a column/value map.

scripts.description: Delete an attachment by sys_id. Returns {success, sys_id} (ServiceNow replies 204 No Content).
scripts.terms: servicenow delete attachment delete an attachment by sys_id. returns {success, sys_id} (servicenow replies 204 no content).

scripts.description: Delete a record by sys_id. Returns {success, sys_id} (ServiceNow replies 204 No Content).
scripts.terms: servicenow delete record delete a record by sys_id. returns {success, sys_id} (servicenow replies 204 no content).

scripts.description: Return the sys_user record of the authenticated user.
scripts.terms: servicenow get current user return the sys_user record of the authenticated user.

scripts.description: Fetch the outcome of a prior import row by the staging-row sys_id returned by Insert Into Import Set (result.sys_id).
scripts.terms: servicenow get import set result fetch the outcome of a prior import row by the staging-row sys_id returned by insert into import set (result.sys_id).

scripts.description: Retrieve a single record by sys_id. Optionally restrict the returned columns, and choose raw vs. display values.
scripts.terms: servicenow get record retrieve a single record by sys_id. optionally restrict the returned columns, and choose raw vs. display values.

scripts.description: Push a row into an import set staging table; the transform map runs synchronously. Inspect result[].status.
scripts.terms: servicenow insert into import set push a row into an import set staging table; the transform map runs synchronously. inspect result[].status.

scripts.description: List attachment metadata, optionally filtered with an encoded query (e.g. table_name=incident^table_sys_id=<id>).
scripts.terms: servicenow list attachments list attachment metadata, optionally filtered with an encoded query (e.g. table_name=incident^table_sys_id=<id>).

scripts.description: Query records from any table with an encoded query (sysparm_query), pagination, column selection, and raw/display values.
scripts.terms: servicenow list records query records from any table with an encoded query (sysparm_query), pagination, column selection, and raw/display values.

scripts.description: List the instance tables (sys_db_object) with API name, label, and sys_id. Optionally filter by a name/label substring.
scripts.terms: servicenow list tables list the instance tables (sys_db_object) with api name, label, and sys_id. optionally filter by a name/label substring.

scripts.description: Update a record by sys_id with a column/value map. PATCH (partial) by default; set replace=true to PUT (full overwrite).
scripts.terms: servicenow update record update a record by sys_id with a column/value map. patch (partial) by default; set replace=true to put (full overwrite).

scripts.description: Emits records whose timestamp is newer than the last poll, tracked via Windmill state. Defaults to sys_updated_on.
scripts.terms: servicenow new or updated record emits records whose timestamp is newer than the last poll, tracked via windmill state. defaults to sys_updated_on.
